statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-49265 (GHSA-xpv3-w29h-x7cv, PYSEC-2026-4114): oauthlib's PKCE checks, code_challenge_method_s256 and code_challenge_method_plain in oauthlib/oauth2/rfc6749/grant_types/authorization_code.py, compared the code verifier with the stored challenge using Python's == operator instead of a constant-time comparison, which leaks timing information. oauthlib 3.0.0 up to but not including 4.0.0 is affected; 4.0.0 fixes it with pull request 963 (commit 74664d3), which compares with hmac.compare_digest: https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/security/advisories/GHSA-xpv3-w29h-x7cv, https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/pull/963, https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/commit/74664d3fe037a354e180e305135c6bab1747a6b0, https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/releases/tag/v4.0.0. k8s-sidecar is a Python application installed in a virtual environment under /usr/lib/k8s-sidecar with its dependencies. We read every published k8s-sidecar package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, 20 builds from 2.10.1-r0 to the current 2.14.3-r5 for x86_64 and aarch64, each checked against the index checksum, walking every file in each package, including the files inside the dateutil-zoneinfo.tar.gz archive that the builds up to 2.14.1-r1 carry. Each build has one copy of oauthlib, in the virtual environment's site-packages; we read its version from its .dist-info metadata and checked authorization_code.py. Every build from 2.10.1-r0 to 2.11.2-r1 ships oauthlib 3.3.1, whose two functions compare with ==. Every build from 2.11.2-r2 to 2.14.3-r2 ships oauthlib 4.0.0 and every build from 2.14.3-r3 to 2.14.3-r5 ships oauthlib 4.0.1; both use hmac.compare_digest in the two functions. The range ends at 2.11.2-r2.
